description: Sends a contact request to a person found in the human's address book, using the same rules as add_contact. It needs the person’s OK first, naming the match by handle and by the name they saved. If that person already asked the human, nothing is accepted here: the answer says incoming_request, and the human decides with respond_contact_request.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string you make up for this action, 8-128 characters (a UUID works). Reuse the same key only to retry this exact call.

name: request_address_book_friendship
title: Send a contact request to an address book match
